what: HF lake publish FAILED for chunks 3 and 4 of run 41552388391 (log: 'Commit of 250/200/125/100/75/50 files failed (BadRequestError ... then HfHubHTTPError ...)'; the HTTP reason is truncated in the log). Chunks 1-2 published. The designed fallback pushed 120 symbols in FULL to the trainer: etf_history 3,688 MB / 15,295 partitions, free disk 45 -> 41 GB. If the lake keeps failing, the remaining 681 symbols add ~20 GB (free ~21 GB; the mid-run stop floor is 10 GB) and every run goes red. Cause undiagnosed; unverified hypotheses: an HF repo commit-rate or size limit. Owner: lane MARKET-DATA-LAKE (scripts/data_lake/hf_publish.py: log the full HfHubHTTPError text/status). UPDATE 2026-11-03 (CAUSE FOUND from the same run log; the reason was on the lines after each failure line): '403 Forbidden: Private storage limit reached for user bentzbk, please upgrade your plan to increase your private storage limit'. The HF account is on the FREE plan (is_pro=false; this repo's PLAN_PRIVATE_BYTES assumes 100 GB private for free, 1 TB for pro); the core crypto lake alone is projected ~50 GB and the ETF 1m base ~31 GB (3,688 MB for ~120 symbols, an inference), so the ETF base cannot fit. Chunks 3-4 (120 symbols) stay on the trainer until space exists. Decision for the operator: upgrade the HF plan (PRO), or free lake space, or accept the trainer as the ETF store of record. hf_publish.py now logs the full reason and treats it as non-retryable (PR for lane ETF-throughput). DECIDED 2026-11-03: operator popup, verbatim 'Keep it on the trainer (Rec.)'. The trainer is the ETF 1m store of record; no HF PRO upgrade; nothing pruned from the lake; the ETF pipeline no longer attempts the HF publish for ETF 1m (ETF_LAKE_PUBLISH=0, one switch to re-enable).
